repos.name: thedotmack/claude-mem
repos.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
repos.eli5: It works like a notebook that remembers everything a robot helper does, so the next time you talk to it, it can pick up where it left off.

repos.name: milind-soni/OpenMausBot
repos.description: Open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use
repos.eli5: Imagine a team of tiny robot friends that live in your chat app and can run their own little computers to help you, like having personal assistants on your phone.

repos.name: pbakaus/impeccable
repos.description: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.
repos.eli5: It's like a style guide for a robot writer, telling it how to make code look neat and catch mistakes before it sends them out.

repos.name: CopilotKit/OpenBot
repos.description: Open-source AI coworkers that each get a computer of their own: a browser, files and tools, with every action decided before it happens and recorded after. Bring any AG-UI agent.
repos.eli5: Think of it as a robot coworker that gets its own browser and desk, does tasks for you, and writes down everything it does so you can check later.

repos.name: Renhuai123/ziwei-doushu
repos.description: 紫微斗数开源排盘引擎 — 基于倪海厦《天纪》体系，含完整排盘算法、四化系统、格局知识库、古籍原文数据
repos.eli5: It's a digital fortune‑telling machine that calculates your birth chart using ancient Chinese rules, like a calculator for astrology.

repos.name: expo/skills
repos.description: A collection of AI agent skills for working with Expo projects and Expo Application Services
repos.eli5: These are cheat‑sheets that teach robot helpers how to build and fix apps made with Expo, just like giving them a recipe book.

repos.name: macro-inc/macro
repos.description: Macro is a unified workspace for teams: email, chat, docs, tasks, agents, calls, and CRM — @-linked together with shared AI memory.
repos.eli5: Imagine a super‑organizer that puts all your emails, chats, docs, and tasks into one big notebook that everyone on the team can read and search.

repos.name: mattpocock/skills
repos.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
repos.eli5: A toolbox of tiny tricks that help robot helpers write real, reliable code, like giving them a set of precise measuring tools.

repos.name: pingdotgg/t3code
repos.eli5: It’s a remote control app that lets you steer your coding robots from your phone or computer, like a game controller for developers.

repos.name: HKUDS/DeepTutor
repos.eli5: A smart tutor that learns how you study and gives you personalized lessons, like a teacher that remembers everything you’ve ever asked about.
